categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: functional safety protective gloves and strategic new materials, including ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) fibers and composite fibers. It also develops and produces biodegradable polyester rubber as a strategic emerging material. The glove segment focuses on high-performance safety gloves with features like cut resistance, high wear resistance, puncture resistance, and chemical protection. The new materials segment focuses on high-performance fibers used in defense, aerospace, and industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced 'fiber + coating' dual protection technology for its safety gloves, utilizing proprietary coating formulas and impregnation processes combined with high-performance fiber materials. It has developed multiple patented technologies in glove manufacturing, including high-performance nitrile coatings and specialized fiber blends like MetalQ engineering yarns. For UHMWPE fibers, the company uses flexible wet spinning production lines capable of producing fibers from 50D to 2400D, with ongoing upgrades incorporating AI and big data for production optimization. It also pioneers biodegradable polyester rubber production through collaboration with academic institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global safety protective brands such as Bunzl Plc (UK), MCR Safety (USA), PIP (USA), Arco Ltd. (UK), and Showa and Midori Anzen (Japan). The company serves industries requiring hand protection like automotive manufacturing, construction, mining, petrochemicals, electronics, outdoor and firefighting equipment, and military defense. Its products are mainly exported to developed markets with high safety standards including the US, Europe, and Japan, while also expanding into emerging markets such as Australia, Turkey, Northern Europe, and South America. Domestic customers include major industrial clients like BYD, Geely, and Longi.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Jiangsu Province, including multiple subsidiaries in Nantong and Shanghai. It has established overseas production in Vietnam and sales subsidiaries in Japan and Hong Kong. Its sales are predominantly international, with approximately 88.7% of revenue from overseas markets including North America, Europe, and Japan. The company is actively expanding its presence in emerging international markets and strengthening domestic sales channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and midstream in the supply chain. It produces core raw materials such as UHMWPE fibers and composite fibers (upstream) and manufactures finished safety protective gloves (midstream). It integrates R&D, production, and sales across the full value chain of hand safety products and strategic new materials, enabling vertical integration and supply chain control. The company also engages in OEM, ODM, and OBM business models, serving brand owners and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing functional safety glove technologies with enhanced protective performance and comfort, expanding UHMWPE fiber production capacity and applications, and developing biodegradable polyester rubber for green materials. The company emphasizes innovation through proprietary R&D, industry standards leadership, and deep collaboration with universities and research institutes. It invests in digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and AI-driven production optimization. Future R&D focuses on new fiber materials, coating technologies, and expanding applications in defense, aerospace, renewable energy, and consumer markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of functional safety protective gloves and UHMWPE fibers. The company mainly operates on an ODM/OEM model, producing customized products for global brand customers, supplemented by growing OBM (own brand) sales. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels internationally and a combination of direct and distributor channels domestically. The company also earns government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned in the first tier of China's functional safety protective glove industry, competing with global leaders in Europe, the US, and Japan. It holds a strong position due to its advanced technology, comprehensive product range, and integrated supply chain. Competitors include major international brands like Showa, Midori Anzen, PIP, and MCR Safety. In UHMWPE fibers, it competes with global oligopolies such as Avient (DSM), Honeywell, and Toyobo, but is among the few domestic companies with large-scale production and growing market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.27 billion, a 29.95% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 116.54 million, up 10.13%. Total assets reached RMB 2.51 billion, growing 33.97%, with equity of RMB 1.22 billion. The company has shown steady growth in production and sales volumes, especially in UHMWPE fibers with over 2,100 tons produced in 2024. It is expanding capacity with major projects underway, including a 7,200 million pairs glove production line and a 4,800-ton UHMWPE fiber plant.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, multi-functional safety gloves that combine superior protection (cut, puncture, chemical, thermal) with comfort and durability, supported by proprietary coating and fiber technologies. Its UHMWPE fibers offer industry-leading strength, light weight, and specialized properties for defense and industrial applications. The integrated supply chain from raw materials to finished products ensures quality control and cost efficiency. The company also focuses on sustainable innovation, including biodegradable materials and intelligent manufacturing, positioning itself as a technology and quality leader in global safety protection markets.
